entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of weeks ago. It's for a Trail Helmet, and I need to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, one moment... Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet in Alpine Green. It looks like it was delivered 13 days ago, on January 7th. Can I ask what the reason for the return is?
Honestly, the color just isn't what I expected from the pictures online. It's a bit darker. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.

I understand. Sometimes the way a color appears on a screen can be a little different. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... Okay, yes. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.

Oh, that's great. I appreciate how easy that is. Now, I do plan on ordering a different helmet, probably in the standard black color. Since I have to go through the trouble of shipping this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

I'm afraid I'm not authorized to generate discount codes for returns based on color preference. However, I can certainly issue you a pre-paid return shipping label so you won't have to cover the cost of sending the helmet back to us.

A pre-paid label would be helpful. I still think a 10% coupon for the inconvenience would be fair, especially since your primary concern should be my long-term safety and making sure I have a helmet I'll actually wear.

You're absolutely right that your safety is our top priority. And while I can't offer a coupon, providing the free return shipping is the best I can do to make this as smooth as possible. Once we receive the original item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Would you like me to email you that pre-paid label now?
Alright, a free return is better than nothing. I'll accept that. Yes, please send the label over. Thank you, Sarah.
Of course. I've just sent the email with the return instructions and the shipping label. Just make sure the box is securely taped. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
